question: After correcting general PAPER exit valuation and accounting without changing runner-watch strategy behavior, does PRE_MIGRATION_RUNNER_WATCH produce at least one independent mint episode per covered hour and durable realizable paper outcomes under a Helius-only runtime feed?

priorEvidence.interpretation: V7 remains valid historical evidence for Helius transport and two zero-throughput hours. Its rows cannot count toward V8 because the frozen protocol required a new era after any exit or source change.

correctionScope.sourceCause: General PAPER positions reused a 120-second cached analysis price for stop checks, did not retain the accepted buy quote token output amount, and closed accounting with incompatible token-price-by-SOL-size units.
allowedChanges: retain the exact positive token output amount from the accepted Jupiter buy quote before debiting the paper wallet
request a fresh Jupiter executable sell quote for that exact token amount on each general PAPER position cycle
evaluate existing PAPER exit rules from executable position value rather than cached analysis price
close PAPER accounting by exit value so accounting and engine realized PnL use the same units
emit bounded PAPER position mark provenance and integrity diagnostics
add regression tests and evidence-report contract validation for the corrected path
unchanged: configured stop-loss, take-profit, trailing, breakeven, and time-exit thresholds

paperExitMeasurementContract.scope: general PAPER positions only; PRE_MIGRATION_RUNNER_WATCH lane behavior is unchanged
paperExitMeasurementContract.entryTokenAmountSource: accepted Jupiter buy quote output amount
paperExitMeasurementContract.markSource: fresh Jupiter executable sell quote for exact entry token amount
paperExitMeasurementContract.markCadence: each general PAPER position update cycle
paperExitMeasurementContract.accountingPnLFormula: executable exit value SOL - entry value SOL - fees
requiredTelemetryWhenPositionOpens: paper.position.opened with positive tokenAmountRaw and positionId
paper.position.marked with JUPITER_EXECUTABLE_SELL_QUOTE for the same positionId
paper.position.closed with JUPITER_EXECUTABLE_SELL_QUOTE when the position closes

providerPlan.coverageSemantics: Time counts only after a current Helius subscription acknowledgement and excludes disconnected or transport-gap intervals.

episodeIdentity: telemetry_run|mint; same-mint reentries within a run count as one episode

throughputCheckpoint.gradeOn: cumulative future-only valid V8 Helius executable-exit sessions

requirements: realized PnL after removing top 3 winning episodes > 0
no single run contributes more than 60% of total positive PnL

prohibitions: No live broadcast enablement from this experiment.
No entry-gate, configured exit-threshold, or provider-coverage changes while evidence is collecting.
No grading on MFE, maximum excursion, or duplicate same-mint reentries.
V1 through V7 rows cannot count as V8 evidence.
PumpPortal and PumpDev runtime events invalidate a V8 run rather than becoming fallback evidence.
Any strategy, threshold, provider, coverage, PAPER exit-measurement, semantic-health, or frozen-source change starts a new pre-registration.
A config-hash, source-fingerprint, missing-Git-commit, dirty-working-tree, or PAPER executable-exit contract mismatch excludes the run from V8 evidence.
